fields.name: Your name
fields.phone_hint: We send a code to this number by SMS.
fields.password_rules: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.email: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
errors.terms: Please accept the terms to create your account.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.text: Free to start. No card needed.
signup.marketing: Send me tips and offers now and then (optional).
signup.closed_text: Accounts at this address are made by the organization that uses it. Ask them to add you.

code.title: Enter the code
code.sent_sms: We sent a code by SMS to
code.sent_mail: We sent a code by email to
code.label: The {length}-digit code
code.hint: It works for 10 minutes. Never share it with anyone.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.text: We send a code to the email or phone of your account.
forgot.effects: Every other device will be signed out, and we tell your email and phone about the change.

welcome.title: Welcome, {name}!
welcome.language: Which language do you like to use?
welcome.country_text: For your currency, dates and local rules.
welcome.work_title: What kind of work is it?
welcome.work_text: We set up your workspace for it. You can skip this.

account.title: My account
account.text: Your name, how you sign in, and your devices. The same wherever you work.
account.locked: Your password was reset recently, so your email and phone are locked until {date}. This protects your account.
account.contact_text: We send a code to the new address. Nothing changes until you enter it, and your old address is told.
account.remove_phone_text: You will sign in and get codes by email only.
account.password_text: Use a password you do not use anywhere else.
account.password_effect: Other devices are signed out when you change it.
account.end_others_text: Every other browser and app using your account is signed out at once.

privacy.data_text: Download everything we keep about you: your account, where you work, your devices, what you agreed to, your payments and your own actions. Your workspace's business data has its own export.
privacy.download_limit: You downloaded your data several times just now. Please try again in an hour.
privacy.delete_text: Your personal data is erased after a waiting period, and your own workspace is closed. Records that belong to organizations you work for stay with them. Invoices are kept as the law requires.
privacy.blocked: Before you can delete your account:
privacy.pending: Your account will be deleted on {date}. Until then you can use it as usual and change your mind.
privacy.dialog_text: We send a notice to your email and phone. You can cancel until the date shown there.
